description: This file contains a PHP class 'Option' within the 'Opencart\Admin\Model\Catalog' namespace. It provides methods for managing product options in an OpenCart system, including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving options, as well as handling descriptions and values associated with options.

classes.name: Option
classes.description: A model class for handling product options in the OpenCart admin catalog module.

methods.name: addOption
methods.description: Inserts a new option into the database, including descriptions and values, returns the new option ID.

methods.name: editOption
methods.description: Updates an existing option's data, including descriptions and values.

methods.name: deleteOption
methods.description: Removes an option and its related descriptions and values from the database.

methods.name: getOption
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific option by ID.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Fetches a list of options with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalOptions
methods.description: Returns the total count of options in the database.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for an option in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with a specific option.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes descriptions for options in a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Fetches all descriptions for a specific option.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions in a specific language.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Adds an option value and its description(s).

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves detailed data for a specific option value by ID.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Returns all values for a given option, including their descriptions.

methods.name: addValueDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for an option value in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteValues
methods.description: Deletes all values associated with an option.

methods.name: deleteValueDescriptionsByOptionId
methods.description: Removes descriptions for option values by option ID.

methods.name: getValueDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Get Value Descriptions By Language ID
